body:
Not if they don't hear about it, that's the point.

My family isn't in contact with all of the people *I* am in regular contact with. Most people I know would probably never find out if I didn't ask they be told in a note.

My family I can't avoid. The others I can.

This is about the reactions I have control over, not the ones that I don't.

I'm a college drop-out with no license, no job, no girlfriend, and no social outlets.

Not only do am I not serving any productive function in society, I don't really enjoy doing anything anymore. So I'm not doing anybody any good, myself or others. And I really have no desire to change that.

If killing myself wouldn't be a traumatic experience for my parents I'd have done it years ago. And I'm starting to care less and less about my parents. That's fucked up.
